name: UR+ AR
summary: Bring robotics into your world with our augmented reality app. This innovative tool allows you to digitally position a Universal Robots arm in your real space, seamlessly turning your surroundings into a digital twin. Ideal for testing robot movements and reachability within your factory or workspace, the app helps you visualize and simulate robotic operations without needing to recreate a digital model of your environment. Discover the power of AR-enhanced robotics visualization and streamline your workflo
